channel.title: Àkàndé: GPT-Powered Voice Assistant for Executives
channel.description: Àkàndé is an open-source Python voice assistant that chains OpenAI Whisper speech recognition, GPT-4 chat completions, and a local SQLite response cache into a voice-driven workflow — generating PDF summaries from conversation history and keeping all stored data local.
